content: <thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 262.099 Da. This corresponds to a protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007 Da) gives a neutral mass of ≈261.092 Da. The formula C₁₃H₁₃N₂O₄ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 261.0875 Da, and its [M+H]⁺ ion is 262.0948 Da, matching the observed m/z within experimental error. No halogen isotopic pattern is present, supporting a formula containing only C, H, N, and O. Therefore the molecular formula is C₁₃H₁₃N₂O₄.
